terms.zh_def: 一个文件夹，加上它里面的会话、记忆和资源。一个项目用一个工作区。
terms.en_def: A folder plus its conversations, memory and resources. Use one per project.
terms.avoid_zh: 空间（引用界面文字时除外）、项目、目录
terms.avoid_en: space (except in API docs: spaceId, /api/spaces), project
terms.note: UI zh varies by label (工作区 / 工作空间 / 空间): always quote the exact label.

terms.zh_def: Halo 自带的工作区，打开 Halo 就在这里，适合临时的事。
terms.en_def: The built-in workspace Halo opens in; good for one-off work.

terms.zh_def: 在某个工作区里和 Halo 的一段对话。
terms.en_def: One chat thread with Halo inside a workspace.
terms.note: Nav rail says 会话; the list section says 对话; the button key "New conversation" shows "New" in English.

terms.zh_def: 能自己干活的 AI 成员：按计划、按事件或在 IM 里被叫到时工作，有自己的记忆和设置。
terms.en_def: An AI member that works on its own — on a schedule, on events or when messaged in IM — with its own memory and settings.
terms.note: Capitalized in English prose, following the README.

terms.zh_def: 几位数字人在一位负责人带领下分工、交接、交付结果；可以临时组建，也可以保存下来。
terms.en_def: Several Digital Humans led by a lead that split a job, hand work over and deliver results; temporary or saved.

terms.zh_def: AI 为当前任务临时组建的团队，任务结束即解散，想保留可以说「保留这个团队」。
terms.en_def: A team the AI assembles for the task at hand; keep it if you want to reuse it.

terms.zh_def: 团队里负责拆分任务、分派工作、在团队决定不了时来问你的成员。
terms.en_def: The team member that plans, assigns work and asks you when the team cannot decide.

terms.zh_def: 有成员在同事电脑上的团队，凭邀请链接加入。成员在同一局域网里直接连到发起团队的电脑（需要打开远程访问），跨网络时经过你们自己部署的联邦网关。
terms.en_def: A team with members on colleagues' computers, joined by an invite link. Members on the same network connect straight to the host computer (with Remote Access on); across networks they go through a Federation Gateway you run yourselves.

terms.zh_def: 你自己部署的中继服务，让不在同一网络的电脑加入同一个团队，负责在它们之间转发消息。
terms.en_def: A relay you deploy yourself so computers on different networks can join one team; it passes messages between them.
terms.note: Settings text: "Relay team collaboration through a gateway server so members outside your local network can join."

terms.zh_def: 输入框 ＋ 里按会话开关的能力。AI 可以请你打开，但不能自己打开。
terms.en_def: Per-conversation switches in the composer ＋. The AI can ask you to turn one on but cannot turn it on itself.
terms.note: Not the same as 能力库 / Capability library.

terms.zh_def: 管理已安装技能和 MCP 服务器的地方。
terms.en_def: Where installed skills and MCP servers are managed.
terms.note: Do not confuse with the composer 能力 / Capabilities.

terms.zh_def: 一份可复用的做事说明（SKILL.md），AI 需要时会用，也可以用 / 调用。
terms.en_def: A reusable instruction package (SKILL.md) the AI uses when relevant, or that you call with /.

terms.zh_def: 通过 Model Context Protocol 接入的外部工具服务。
terms.en_def: An external tool server connected through the Model Context Protocol.

terms.zh_def: 你的资料，在本机提取成可检索的文字；AI 回答时查阅，并列出「来源」。
terms.en_def: Your documents, extracted on your computer into searchable text; the AI reads them and lists its sources.

terms.zh_def: Halo 在会话之间记住的东西：同一工作区的会话共享工作区记忆；每位数字人有自己的记忆（当前状态、历史、主题）。
terms.en_def: What Halo keeps between conversations: conversations in a workspace share workspace memory; each Digital Human has its own (current state, history, topics).
terms.note: Not the knowledge base: memory is written by the AI, a knowledge base holds your documents.

terms.zh_def: 记忆里关于某一件事的一页笔记，由 AI 编写和整理。
terms.en_def: One page of memory about one subject, written and tidied by the AI.
terms.note: Appears in counts such as "{{count}} topics" / 「{{count}} 个主题」.

terms.zh_def: 所有工作区里正在运行的工作和等你处理的问题，集中在一个列表。
terms.en_def: One list of running work and questions waiting for you, across all workspaces.

terms.zh_def: 查看工作区 Git 仓库的改动、暂存、提交，并让 AI 评审。
terms.en_def: See, stage and commit Git changes in the workspace, and have the AI review them.

terms.zh_def: 右侧的多标签查看区，用来看文件、浏览器、终端、团队和变更。
terms.en_def: The tabbed viewer on the right for files, the browser, the terminal, the team view and changes.

terms.zh_def: 右侧栏，有文件、数字人、技能、MCP 几个标签。
terms.en_def: The right rail with Files, Digital Humans, Skill and MCP tabs.

terms.zh_def: Halo 内置的浏览器，AI 用你已登录的状态操作网页；你可以旁观和接手。
terms.en_def: A built-in browser the AI operates with your signed-in sessions; you can watch and take over.
terms.note: The composer switch that enables it is 网页控制 / Web Control.

terms.zh_def: 你和 AI 共用、一直开着的终端。
terms.en_def: A persistent terminal you and the AI share.

terms.zh_def: 浏览并安装数字人和技能；「设置 › 应用商店」管理商店来源。
terms.en_def: Browse and install Digital Humans and skills; Settings › App Store manages the sources.
terms.avoid_zh: 市场、应用市场（除非引用旧版本）

terms.zh_def: 连接 IM 和邮件：双向机器人绑定到一位数字人；单向通知渠道只负责发出消息。
terms.en_def: Connections to IM and email: two-way bots bound to one Digital Human, and one-way notification channels.

terms.zh_def: IM 那一端的身份（企业微信、飞书、微信里），把消息转给一位数字人。
terms.en_def: The identity on the IM side (WeCom, Feishu, WeChat) that relays messages to one Digital Human.

terms.zh_def: 一位数字人可以主动发消息的会话。
terms.en_def: The chats a Digital Human may send messages to on its own.

terms.zh_def: 决定通过机器人找数字人的人能让它做什么：主人拥有完整权限，访客只能用允许的工具。
terms.en_def: Decides what people messaging a bot can make its Digital Human do: the owner has full access, guests only the allowed tools.

terms.zh_def: 主人是机器人认定的你本人：第一个私聊这个机器人的人会成为主人；访客是通过机器人发消息的其他人。
terms.en_def: The owner is you, as the bot knows you: the first person to message the bot directly becomes its owner. Guests are everyone else who messages the bot.

terms.zh_def: 在数字人的聊天里说一句就能设置的一次性或重复提醒。
terms.en_def: A one-off or recurring reminder you set by asking a Digital Human in its chat.

ui.key: Only on mainland China working days
ui.en: Only on mainland China working days

terms.zh_def: 数字人什么时候自己运行。
terms.en_def: When a Digital Human runs by itself.

terms.zh_def: 让数字人开始一次运行的条件：计划、事件或消息。
terms.en_def: What starts a run: a schedule, an event or a message.

terms.zh_def: 数字人完成一次任务的过程，留有可查看的记录。
terms.en_def: One execution of a Digital Human's job, with a record you can open.

terms.zh_def: 数字人的设置页：模型、工具与资源、记忆、通知等。
terms.en_def: A Digital Human's settings: model, tools and resources, memory, notifications and more.

terms.zh: 模型 / AI 来源 / 提供商
terms.zh_def: AI 来源是一个账号或一个 Key；每个来源提供若干模型；模型按会话选择。
terms.en_def: An AI source is one account or key; each offers models; the model is chosen per conversation.

terms.zh_def: 模型回答前思考的深浅，从「关闭」到「最大」，按会话设置。
terms.en_def: How much the model reasons before answering, from Off to Max, set per conversation.
terms.avoid_zh: 推理强度、思考强度（只作别名）

terms.zh_def: 提供商报告的剩余额度，只在提供商支持时显示。
terms.en_def: The allowance left, shown only when the provider reports it.

terms.zh_def: 驱动 AI 干活的运行时：默认是 Claude Code SDK，另有 Halo SDK、Codex SDK 和 DeepSeek dsh（后三个为实验性）。
terms.en_def: The runtime that drives the AI's work: Claude Code SDK by default, plus Halo SDK, Codex SDK and DeepSeek dsh (the last three are experimental).

terms.zh_def: 用手机或其他设备打开你的 Halo，局域网或互联网都可以；也是 HTTP API 的入口。
terms.en_def: Open your Halo from a phone or another device, on your network or over the internet; also the door to the HTTP API.

terms.zh_def: 一项能力：打开后，AI 可以通过 Halo 自己的接口替你改设置、管理工作区和数字人。
terms.en_def: A capability that lets the AI change settings and manage workspaces and Digital Humans through Halo's own API.

terms.zh_def: 让 AI 读取同一工作区的另一个会话，或直接给它发消息。
terms.en_def: Let the AI read another conversation in the workspace, or message it directly.

terms.zh_def: 给会话设定的目标和「完成标准」，上下文被压缩后也会保留。
terms.en_def: An objective plus "done when" criteria set for a conversation; it survives context compaction.
terms.note: Halo SDK engine only in 3.0.4 (inventory area 01).

terms.zh_def: IM 里回复超过一定时间时先发出的「正在处理」提示，可以关闭。
terms.en_def: The "working on it" message a bot sends in IM when a reply takes a while; can be turned off.

terms.zh_def: 可分享的数字人文件：.dhpkg、.zip、.yaml，或含 spec.yaml 的文件夹。
terms.en_def: A shareable Digital Human file: .dhpkg, .zip, .yaml, or a folder with spec.yaml.
terms.note: Formats from the import dialog text.

terms.zh_def: 以服务形式运行的无界面 Halo，用浏览器打开同样的界面。
terms.en_def: Headless Halo run as a service, with the same UI in a browser.

terms.zh_def: 打开后输出更详细的诊断日志。
terms.en_def: Writes more detailed diagnostic logs.
